messages:
Lina: FYI I hit a routing/attribution quirk during integration tests. When a request carries both an org API key and a project-scoped service-account token, the router is attributing to org. That breaks per-project throttles and the console graph.
Tom: can you paste the minimal headers you used?
Lina: sure:
```
Authorization: ApiKey org:org-7,key=abc
X-Service-Account-Token: sa:sa-99,claims=none
```
Currently parser treats ApiKey as valid principal first. Proposal: prefer the most-specific scope (project/service-account acting_on_project) over org.
Priya: agree on preferring specificity. Observability ask: emit both chosen_principal and all_candidates in logs so we can debug regressions.
Tom: implementation notes: (a) cache keys need scope baked in to avoid cross-scope cache hits, (b) some legacy clients might rely on org-first behavior so keep feature flagged.
Lina: plan: add runtime flag `auth.prefer_specific_scope=false` default, with canary rollout. Also change cache namespace to include scope like `auth_cache:v3|{scope}:{id}`.
Priya: I'll add a Prometheus counter `auth_resolution_total{result="project|org|sa|ambiguous"}` and a histogram for time-to-auth. Set alert if ambiguous/unknown > 1% during canary.
Kara: product concern: switching attribution could change billing for some project owners. Let's surface a console notice when the flag is enabled org-wide and send an alert email to org admins if we detect >2% billing delta.
Tom: tests: unit tests for header precedence, integration test with proxy ordering variations, and an end-to-end billing diff test in staging.
DeployBot: canary deploy started by @priya — id cny-2026-03-21-18, target 3% traffic in eu-west1.
Lina: opened ticket infra/auth-attrib-2026 and console PR for admin toggle + notice. Will post metrics after 6h.
Kara: I'll write banner copy and quick FAQ for support. Keep copy simple: "We're improving how we attribute requests that contain multiple auth tokens. You may see short-term changes in project usage reporting."
Tom: also add a regression harness that replays historical traffic against both resolvers for diffing.
Lina: thanks all, will update thread with canary results. :thumbsup:
